interview.hardest_part: Real-time combat and dodging, especially killing the first-floor boss and surviving later rooms with limited health while acting through slow screenshot-by-screenshot decisions.
interview.likely_failure: Death in an early enemy room or on the floor-1 boss due to delayed reactions, projectiles/enemy contact, or poor pathing while trying to find and enter the boss room.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Simple top-down controls, simultaneous movement and firing, auto-collected pickups, fixed seed allowing memorization across attempts, and doors only locking during combat.
interview.harmful_mechanics: The game keeps running while I think, enemies and projectiles move continuously, health is scarce and persistent within an episode, combat requires precise kiting and aiming, and progress resets on death.
